== Biography ==
'''Elizabeth Glasgow''' was baptised at Libberton, Lanarkshire, on 10 Jun 1726. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4168|Robert Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Watson-53558|Katherine Watson]].<ref name="FMP1">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4033496&tab=this Findmypast, Elizabeth Glasgow, 10 June 1726, Libberton OPR 650/1 p.26; father Robert Glasgow, mother Katherine Watson, residence Whitrafles; held transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/4033496]. Held transcript; original register image not newly inspected.</ref> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Libberton is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

Elizabeth Glasgow was one of the children recorded to Robert Glasgow and Katherine Watson in the Libberton register, alongside [[Glasgow-4133|Agnes]] (1720).
